title: Italian Seed Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful Italian-inspired dish made with pilaf, poppy seeds, and a hint of Canadian spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Canadian seed and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly toasted.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Stir in the poppy seeds and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
